messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Basaglar manufactured by: Eli Lilly and Company, Indianapolis, IN 46285 USA.
Lantus manufactured by: sanofi-aventis U.S. LLC, Bridgewater, NJ 08807, A SANOFI COMPANY.
Langlara manufactured by: Sunshine Lake Pharma, China; its U.S. distributor is Lanexa Biologics/Lannett.
Rezvoglar manufactured by: Eli Lilly and Company, Indianapolis, IN 46285, USA.
Semglee manufactured by: Biocon Biologics Inc. 245 Main St, 2nd Floor, Cambridge, MA 02142 USA.
Toujeo manufactured by: sanofi-aventis U.S. LLC, Bridgewater, NJ 08807, A SANOFI COMPANY.
Triplet: ["Toujeo", "manufacturer location", "Bridgewater, NJ 08807"]

The relation 'manufacturer location' in the triplet is defined as 'The company that manufactures the subject drug is located in the geographic location specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
B. 'has brand name': The subject drug is marketed under the brand or trade name specified by the object entity.
C. 'located in': The subject entity is situated or based in the location specified by the object entity.
D. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
E. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
